description: This source file defines a 'Logo' class for a graphical animation involving moving logo images that bounce within a window. It includes setup and draw functions typical of graphical applications, manages multiple Logo instances, and handles collision with boundaries.

classes.name: Logo
classes.description: A class representing a logo sprite with position, velocity, size, and methods for movement, collision detection, and rendering.

methods.name: Logo:init
methods.description: Initializes a Logo instance with position, velocity, and size.

methods.name: Logo:collision
methods.description: Handles collision detection with window boundaries and inverts velocity upon collision.

methods.name: Logo:move
methods.description: Updates the position of the logo based on velocity and handles collision detection.

methods.name: Logo:draw
methods.description: Renders the logo image at its current position.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the graphics window, creates multiple logos with random positions and velocities, loads the image, and sets frame rate.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Clears the background and updates all logos by drawing and moving them.
